programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA) Programme (two-year, formerly PGP)
programs.feeNote: Fee for the 2024-26 batch, plus INR 20,000 caution deposit. No newer official fee document was found.

feeSource.title: IIM Calcutta - MBA Programme Fee Structure (61st Batch, 2024-2026), Domestic Candidates
feeSource.quote: In addition to the total fees of INR27,00,000/- (INR Twenty Seven Lakh only) for two years, a student will have to pay a caution deposit of INR20,000/- (INR Twenty Thousand only) at the time of registration.

programs.intakeNote: NIRF 2025 sanctioned intake (academic year 2023-24) for all 2-year PG programmes of the institute combined, not only this programme.
